description: Markdown syntax repairs for malformed upstream baseline sources. Each entry is keyed by the SHA-256 of the entire original baseline file in translation/source/ and applies only to that exact text. Every 'before' string must occur exactly once. The files in translation/source/ are never modified; the repairs are applied in memory to the baseline used for translation, checks and English heading IDs.
